description: This file defines the EmpDirectDebit entity class within the OrangeHRM project, representing direct debit details associated with employee salaries. It includes ORM mappings for database persistence and accessor methods.

classes.name: EmpDirectDebit
classes.description: Entity class representing direct debit information associated with an employee's salary, including bank account details, routing number, amount, account type, and transaction type.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the direct debit record.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the direct debit record.

methods.name: getSalary
methods.description: Returns the EmployeeSalary object associated with this direct debit.

methods.name: setSalary
methods.description: Associates an EmployeeSalary object with this direct debit.

methods.name: getRoutingNumber
methods.description: Returns the routing number for the bank account.

methods.name: setRoutingNumber
methods.description: Sets the routing number for the bank account.

methods.name: getAmount
methods.description: Returns the amount to be debited.

methods.name: setAmount
methods.description: Sets the amount to be debited.

methods.name: getAccountType
methods.description: Returns the account type (SAVINGS, CHECKING, OTHER).
